artifacts.title: Chapter 3 five-year series import
artifacts.claim: The five-year upset series is imported and transformed into the total upset-rate series used by Chapter 3.

artifacts.title: Chapter 3 five-year exact-risk schedules
artifacts.claim: The fixed/current/delayed schedules are compiled on the dissertation geometry and target probability.

artifacts.title: Model-to-RTL schedule replay certificate
artifacts.claim: The RTL controller executes model-generated period indices with zero pass-count mismatch on representative windows.

artifacts.title: Radiation-window fault replay
artifacts.claim: The selected radiation windows are replayed with fault streams and separated DUE/persistent/SDC-audit metrics.

artifacts.title: Interleaving MBU experiment
artifacts.claim: The same physical MBU is dangerous without interleaving and correctable when split across codewords.

artifacts.title: Diagnostic supervisor RTL
artifacts.claim: The diagnostic block raises alert, persistent-DUE, out-of-envelope, and force-conservative flags from SEC-DED symptoms.

artifacts.title: Integrated diagnostic controller RTL
artifacts.claim: The top-level external-period controller exposes diagnostic flags from real scrub events.

artifacts.title: rho_D residual-budget sweep
artifacts.claim: The residual-budget boundary is reproduced numerically; above rho_crit, tau_min is insufficient.

artifacts.title: Accumulated-risk Monte Carlo validation
artifacts.claim: The exact accumulated-risk kernel is validated by direct random placement at accelerated lambda values.

artifacts.title: Measured-error period estimator RTL
artifacts.claim: The onboard estimator relaxes on quiet passes, speeds up on corrections, and forces safe period on DUE.

artifacts.title: Integrated measured-error controller RTL
artifacts.claim: The measured-error estimator is integrated into a complete autonomous scrub controller.

artifacts.title: Measured-error policy model evaluation
artifacts.claim: Counter-based measured-error policies are evaluated on the five-year series; conservative settings meet the target but use more passes than external exact-risk schedules.

artifacts.title: RTL synthesis/resource summary
artifacts.claim: Flattened Yosys/XC7 synthesis estimates quantify the hardware cost of the blocks.

artifacts.title: Overhead/gain certificate
artifacts.claim: Schedule benefit and RTL resource cost are combined in one certificate.
